recent.text: Jamahl Mosley on Jordan Poole (28 pts, 6/8 on 3s): "He was aggressive. His teammates were finding him. We ran a couple after-timeout plays for him to get him going. He continued to make the right play, but also knocked shots down." https://t.co/LuuDTPeStE
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Suns stave off red-hot shooting night from Jordan Poole (28 pts, 6 of 8 on 3s), rally from late deficits to overtake #Pelicans 123-119 in overtime. Zion Williamson 25 pts; Saddiq Bey 21 pts. Postgame wrap: https://t.co/scx9EfwJ1e https://t.co/HlLRxIstuF
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Suns win 123-119 in OT, as #Pelicans drop to 2-2 this season in OT games. A tough outcome after New Orleans had several good performances and stretches where it seemed like a win might be coming
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer
recent.quoted_text: Suns lead cut to 120-117 with 25 seconds left in OT on Saddiq Bey's difficult off-balance trey. #Pelicans are probably going to have to go for steal then foul because only 1 second between shot and game clock

recent.text: Pelicans lose 123-119 in overtime. Tough loss. Team fought hard (17 OREB!) but 6 missed free throws in 4th quarter loom large. Jordan Poole: 28 PTS, 6 3s Zion Williamson: 25 PTS, 6 REB Saddiq Bey: 21 PTS Derik Queen: 11 PTS, 9 REB Jeremiah Fears: 7 PTS (3-17 FG), 7 REB, 11 AST
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Herb Jones (who else?) comes up with a steal on Phoenix's final possession and attempt to win it in regulation. #Pelicans love working overtime this season and we're headed there again
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer
recent.quoted_text: It's been a rough shooting night for Jeremiah Fears but his driving lefty layup with 22 seconds left ties it at 109. Fears 6 pts, 3/15 from field but that third hoop was big

recent.text: We're headed to overtime after Herb Jones comes up with the steal. Have to love the Pelicans doubling Devin Booker TWICE during that Suns final possession to force the ball out of his hands.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: ZERO FEARS TIES US UP https://t.co/dSBqfwOf0z
recent.author: New Orleans Pelicans

recent.text: It's been a rough shooting night for Jeremiah Fears but his driving lefty layup with 22 seconds left ties it at 109. Fears 6 pts, 3/15 from field but that third hoop was big
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Jeremiah Fears cooks Dillon Brooks from the perimeter and his lay-in ties the score at 109. Suns will have the ball with 22.8 seconds left.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Zion Williamson is LIVID there was no whistle on his last drive. Fortunately, Jeremiah Fears forces a jump ball and wins it against Dillon Brooks. Saddiq Bey has two FTS in a 107-106 deficit with 46.3 seconds left.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Queen had a gorgeous spin move to score another hoop vs. Brooks after this. #Pelicans are going to him and Suns having trouble stopping him from getting to basket
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Crowd erupts that Bryce McGowens didn't draw a jump ball on Dillion Brooks. Let's just say that the referee'ing in this game has been suspect.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Pelicans lead Suns 83-79 after three quarters. A New Orleans 16-2 run flipped the momentum, though Phoenix closed the frame scoring six straight points. Jordan Poole: 28 PTS (9-10 FG), 6 3s Zion Williamson: 17 PTS Saddiq Bey: 11 PTS
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Poole 28 pts end 3Q. He made his first nine shots from the field, including his first six three-pointers, prior to finally missing a shot from the top of the arc
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: The Pelicans bench has been lights out, with Jordan Poole leading the charge. Best sequence: He took a charge on one end and then knocked down a 3-pointer with time running out on the shot clock -- plus there was a flagrant foul -- so a six-point play. Pels lead Suns 80-73
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: We now return to the Jordan Poole Show. He's up to 24 pts after drilling a difficult, leaning 3 from the left wing (and being fouled). Put Pels up 75-73 late 3Q
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Fans appreciate that block of Miles Bridges by Yves Missi after watching several replays of a questionable offensive foul on Saddiq Bey. (Devin Booker sells another one.)
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Jeremiah Fears and Zion Williamson failing to connect on a simple pass to began the second half with a turnover is such a poor look.
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: With Saddiq Bey returning to coming off bench, maybe it's not coincidence that second unit was back to its opening-of-season excellence (also Jordan Poole was on fire, that helps). First half shooting from the field by #Pelicans: Starters 7/25 (28%) Reserves 14/21 (67%)
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Pelicans trail Suns 56-54 at halftime. Could sense some frustration from several Pels, like Fears, who was arguing with an NBA official well after the buzzer. Jordan Poole: 17 PTS, 4 3s Saddiq Bey: 11 PTS Zion Williamson: 9 PTS Jeremiah Fears: 0 PTS (0-8 FG)
